Many childhood memories, although a bit foggy, of Danny as we competed in sports like YMCA Baseball and Kids Inc football in our early years in Amarillo. In fact, we competed against each other all the way through high school. Danny has always been a great athlete and a great storyteller. One of the stories he loves to tell is about a hanging curve ball he threw over the middle of the plate in the Amarillo High/ Tascosa game our junior year. It’s one of the few times I took advantage of him and hit an opposite field triple earning a couple of RBI’s to help our team (AHS) clinch a win.  

There are numerous stories around escapades with Ross, Watson and Buckley that shall be forever fondly remembered but rarely shared to protect the innocent.
